description: Predict transition-metal binding sites in protein structures with interpretable template matches, viewable structures and PyMOL sessions.
functions: Predict binding sites for transition metals: zinc (Zn), iron (Fe), manganese (Mn), cobalt (Co), copper (Cu) and nickel (Ni). Zinc-trained and benchmarked across these metals; site markers locate binding sites without assigning the bound metal identity.

The published study reports high precision and recall for its transition-metal panel at probability >= 0.75. In its separate zinc coverage benchmark, sensitivity was 97.7% (1551/1588 zinc sites) at probability >= 0.5. See the Paper link for benchmark conditions.

Upload many PDB/mmCIF structures, archives, or prepared ID-batch ZIP parts together. There is no fixed structure-count, per-structure byte, protein-residue or returned-site cap. All sites meeting the selected probability threshold are returned. Tamarind upload files are limited to 200 MB each; prepared batches are split by upload bytes when needed.

For IDs, use Prepare Tamarind Batch in Colab: https://colab.research.google.com/github/MECHTI1/ZincSight/blob/feature/tamarind-integration/integrations/tamarind/Prepare_Tamarind_Batch.ipynb . Paste PDB/assembly, UniProt, full AlphaFold, MGYP or TED IDs, or upload ID lists, then upload every generated ZIP part here.

Summary has one row and viewable structure per input, including zero-site results. Predicted sites lists all qualifying sites and coordinating residues. Files provides one named structure and PyMOL session per input, the full prediction JSON, citation and complete results ZIP with full-precision mmCIF and detailed annotations.

Eight vCPUs, 24 GiB memory and 50 GiB working disk support large batches, with a 3 GiB worker budget and up to two hours per job. CPU workers defaults to 8. Histidine rotamer sampling is enabled by default. Batch size is governed by the actual memory, disk and job-time allocation.

Please cite Mechtinger G, Axel G, Kolodny R, Ben-Tal N. Interpretable prediction of zinc ion location in proteins with ZincSight. Protein Science. 2025;34(11):e70350. https://doi.org/10.1002/pro.70350 . CITATION.txt and bundled BibTeX reference this paper; Tamarind controls its native Citations tab separately.

inputs.name: structures
inputs.descr: Upload one or many PDB/mmCIF structures, or use batch archives below. Every protein chain in the first model is analyzed; side-chain coordinates are required. No fixed structure-count or protein-size cap. Each uploaded file must fit the platform transport limit.

inputs.name: batch_archive
inputs.displayName: Batch archives or prepared ID batches
inputs.descr: Upload one or more ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ or TGZ archives containing structures. For IDs, upload every ZIP part produced by Prepare Tamarind Batch. Each upload is limited to 200 MB by Tamarind transport; the number of structures is not capped.

inputs.name: histidine_rotamers
inputs.descr: Enabled by default. Samples alternative histidine side-chain orientations to improve sensitivity, with a possible small increase in false positives. Disable to use the input orientations only.

inputs.name: minimum_probability
inputs.descr: Return every site meeting this probability cutoff. Default 0.0001 matches BatchDrive; use a higher cutoff to focus on higher-scoring sites.

inputs.name: cpu_workers
inputs.descr: Use 1–8 CPU workers within the 8-vCPU/24-GiB job allocation. Default 8; 3 GiB is budgeted per worker. Actual parallel speed depends on structure size and batch workload.

producedOutputs.name: Summary
producedOutputs.descr: One row per input with qualifying-site count, highest probability, result status and a viewable structure.

columns.name: sites
columns.description: All sites meeting the selected probability threshold.

columns.name: top_probability
columns.description: Highest site probability; blank when no sites meet the threshold.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Prediction status, including inputs with no qualifying sites.

columns.name: structure_file
columns.description: First-model original atoms and ions plus annotated predicted-site Zn markers. Markers locate potential sites and do not assign bound metal identity.

producedOutputs.name: Predicted sites
producedOutputs.descr: All qualifying sites across the batch with probabilities, coordinating residues and matched templates.

producedOutputs.name: Structures with predicted sites
producedOutputs.descr: One canonical first-model structure per input, in PDB or fallback mmCIF format, retaining original atoms and ions and adding annotated predicted-site markers. Full-precision mmCIF for every input is included in the complete results ZIP.
